Name: Multiplayer Idle
Author: zszs1452
Description:
Stardew Valley mod that pause time when player are idle for multiplayer.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]

Time will be paused automatically when someone are idle in multiplayer.

All players need to install this mod.

Idle checking  default time is 3s, but you can edit the config.json file in a text editor to change that.

There are two kinds of ways to check idle. You can press 'p' to switch. also you can change it in config.json file.
[list]
[*]SINGLE : if any player meet idle condition, time will be paused.
[*]ALL : if all player meet idle condition, time will be paused.

[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer. 
[/list]
